recipe_version.title: Vietnamese Bún Chả: Grilled Pork Patties with Noodles and Herbs
recipe_version.description: Hanoi's lunchtime classic: caramelized pork patties seasoned with shallot, garlic, fish sauce, and sugar, grilled over high heat and served swimming in warm, sweet-tart nước chấm, with cool rice vermicelli, a heap of lettuce and fresh herbs, and quick-pickled carrot.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.preparation: 2 minced for the patties, 2 minced for the sauce

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp patties, 1/4 cup nước chấm, 1 tsp pickles

steps.title: Preheat and prep
steps.body: Turn the grill on to medium-high (about 450 F) to preheat with the lid closed; it heats through this prep. Put 16 cups (4 quarts) water in a 6- to 8-quart pot over high heat. Mix the pork with the shallots, 2 cloves garlic, 2 tbsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp sugar, and the pepper; form 16 small round patties about 2 inches across and 1/2 inch thick. For the nước chấm, stir 1/4 cup sugar into 1 cup warm water until dissolved, then add 6 tbsp fish sauce, the lime juice, the remaining garlic, and the chiles. Toss the carrot with the rice vinegar, 1 tsp sugar, and the salt. Wash and dry the lettuce and herbs and arrange on a platter.

steps.title: Grill the patties
steps.body: Brush the hot grates with oil. Grill the patties with the lid open, 4 to 5 minutes per side, until charred in spots and 160 F in the center.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.body: While the patties grill, add the noodles to the 4 quarts of boiling water and cook until tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain in a colander, rinse under cold running tap until cool, and drain well. Runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Soak and serve
steps.body: Divide the nước chấm among 4 bowls, add 4 patties and some pickled carrot to each, and let them sit 2 minutes. Serve each bowl with a nest of noodles and the herb platter; diners dip noodles and herbs into the bowl.

equipment: gas or charcoal grill, or a grill pan
